Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the SWF domain.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. Tag keys are case-sensitive and must be unique per SWF domain.

Value.description: The value associated with the tag key on the SWF domain. May be an empty string.

schema.description: Resource type definition for AWS::SWF::Domain. An Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF) domain is a logical container for workflow executions, activity types, and workflow types. This type is read-only: domains are provisioned out-of-band and referenced/read through CloudFormation.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain.

Description.description: A text description of the SWF domain, provided at registration. This value is immutable once the domain is created.

Name.description: The name of the domain. The name must be unique within the region in which the domain is registered.

Status.description: The registration status of the domain. A domain can be in REGISTERED or DEPRECATED state.

Tags.description: An array of key-value pairs applied to the domain.

WorkflowExecutionRetentionPeriodInDays.description: The duration (in days) that records and histories of workflow executions on the domain should be kept by the service. Valid values are 0-90 days, or the string NONE. A value of 0 or NONE means no retention.
